parallels.note: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

translations.web: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
translations.bsb: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.
translations.kjv: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
translations.asv: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
